name: nocturneai
description: Policy-first control plane for authorized security assessments.

scripts.test:coverage: npm run build && c8 --all --check-coverage --lines 100 --functions 100 --branches 100 --statements 100 --include=dist/apps/**/src/**/*.js --include=dist/packages/**/src/**/*.js node --test dist/tests/**/*.test.js
scripts.release:gate: npm run test:coverage && npm run validate:release
